science.claim: Exact conditional finite-sample response-vs-artifact separation for known template under Lipschitz nuisance and bounded sample errors.
science.boundary: |a(s_j-s_i)| <= 2L*dt+4eps for every pair iff the response and zero-response observation sets overlap.
science.proof: McShane-type Lipschitz interval extension, constructive witness, independently checked locally with linear programming.
science.novelty: Mathematics is established Lipschitz/set-membership theory. Application to RGB pupil measurement is conditional and not yet empirically validated.

product.allow: Known-probe amplitude certification only with independent real-device bounds on ALL residual optical/gaze/aperture/photometric effects, exposure and clock.
product.reject: Uncalibrated anatomical pupil waveform, generic fatigue inference, automatic transfer from synthetic to consumer RGB.
product.abstain: If A<=Acrit or nuisance bounds unavailable.
product.gate: 75% accurate admitted windows at >=50% reference-blind coverage on untouched human paired data.
